propositions: Serena write_memory tool requires approval_mode configuration in .codex/config.toml to permit MCP tool execution without manual approval.
Project-local .codex/config.toml must be parseable with approval_mode = "approve" for the write_memory tool under mcp_servers.serena.tools.
Codex must accept the modified configuration when invoked with --strict-config flag, rejecting unknown keys rather than silently ignoring them.
Existing Serena server configuration fields (command, args, startup_timeout_sec, enabled) must remain unchanged after adding the write_memory approval_mode setting.
